items.text: haan ji
kal tak
chinta mat karo

items.context: Do you want the cheque book delivered to your home address?
items.text: theek hai

items.context: When do you need the cheque book by?
items.text: jaldi bhej dijiye

items.context: Have you received the cheque book we dispatched last week?
items.text: nahi mila abhi
mera naya cheque book kab tak ayega
umm matlab thoda jaldi bhej dijiye please
mera account number 123456789 hai cheque book ke liye
haan ji mujhe cheque book ki delivery status batayein
deliver kis din hogi mujhe batana please
accha ji last time to kab cheque book aaya tha
mera bohot urgent hai cheque book abhi chahiye mujhe

items.context: Delivery will take at least three days sir, is that okay?
items.text: thodi der aur lag sakti hai kya delivery mein

items.context: Did you apply for the cheque book online or at the branch?
items.text: jis branch se apply kiya tha wahan se expedited ho jayega

items.context: Is your delivery address same as registered on your account?
items.text: mera address same hai par thoda update karna hai

items.context: We are trying to deliver it early, do you want to wait for a couple of days?
items.text: matlab thoda wait kar lunga agar jaldi nahi aaya to

items.context: Can you confirm the date when you applied for the cheque book?
items.text: Tuesday ko apply kiya tha nahi Wednesday hua tha apply
mera last cheque book khatam ho gaya hai to mujhe naya cheque book chahiye thoda urgently
main yeh confirm karna chahta hu ke mera cheque book abhi tak dispatch hua hai ya nahi
agar possible ho to kya aap mujhe mera cheque book jaldi deliver kar sakte ho kyunki mere paas abhi kuch important payments ke liye zarurat hai

items.context: Can you please provide the status of your cheque book delivery?
items.text: meray cheque book ki delivery ka status bata sakte hain please mujhe pata karna hai ki kab tak milega

items.context: Where did you apply for your cheque book, may I know?
items.text: mai ne apne branch me apply kiya tha to check karna hai ki mera cheque book dispatch hua ki nahi ab tak

items.context: Can you tell me the delivery location and if there are any delays expected?
items.text: mera address Pune ka hai aur wahan se maine cheque book manga tha delivery me kuch delay to nahi hoga na

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: banking
Intent: cheque_book - requests a new cheque book or asks about its delivery
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
